description:
General Information
All parts ship from Lexington, KY
NEW in the Original Packaging
What is This?
This is the Suzuki Emblem for Tailgate, Fender & Grill Applications.
Unlike the OEM “S” this Emblem does not have the locating posts on the back so it can be installed on any flat surface such as the Tailgate, Fender & Grill Applications.
Peel-off adhesive backing so it can be installed ANYWHERE with no tools or additional parts.
Mirrored chrome finish.
SIZE: 81mm wide x 66mm tall (3.18in. x 2.59in.)
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Suzuki œS Emblem
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai
SJ413
SJ410
X-90
Vitara
Escudo
Sidekick
Jimny
